args.content:
def collapse_ints(nums: list[int]) -> str:
    """Sort distinct ints; join with commas; runs of 4+ consecutive as first-last.

    A negative endpoint inside a range is written in parentheses; outside a
    range, numbers are written plainly. collapse_ints([]) == "".
    """
    if not nums:
        return ""
    distinct = sorted(set(nums))
    parts: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    n = len(distinct)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and distinct[j + 1] == distinct[j] + 1:
            j += 1
        run_len = j - i + 1
        if run_len >= 4:
            start = distinct[i]
            end = distinct[j]
            start_s = f"({start})" if start < 0 else str(start)
            end_s = f"({end})" if end < 0 else str(end)
            parts.append(f"{start_s}-{end_s}")
        else:
            for k in range(i, j + 1):
                parts.append(str(distinct[k]))
        i = j + 1
    return ",".join(parts)

{"path":"solution.py","content":"def collapse_ints(nums: list[int]) -> str:
    """Sort distinct ints; join with commas; runs of 4+ consecutive as first-last.

    A negative endpoint inside a range is written in parentheses; outside a
    range, numbers are written plainly. collapse_ints([]) == "".
    """
    if not nums:
        return ""
    distinct = sorted(set(nums))
    parts: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    n = len(distinct)
    while i < n:
        j = i
        while j + 1 < n and distinct[j + 1] == distinct[j] + 1:

        run_len = j - i + 1

            end_s = f"({end})" if end < 0 else str(end)
            parts.append(f"{start_s}-{end_s}")
        else:
            for k in range(i, j + 1):
                parts.append(str(distinct[k]))
        i = j + 1
    return ",".join(parts)
"}
